envelope.description: Real CLIs and the real panel

body.title: Real CLIs and the real panel
body.summary: Checks the gate cannot run, reported by the builder. With the argv each adapter builds for a request with readDirs, the real claude CLI and the real codex CLI answer from an image and a text file in that directory. Then the build is installed and, after the user reloads the window, pasting a screenshot and attaching a document are checked in the panel. The whole plugin suite is run and its TAP output saved to a file that is named as evidence.
acceptanceChecks: Reported: claude, run with the adapter's own argv for a request with readDirs, answers from the image and the text file
Reported: codex, run with the adapter's own argv, answers from the image and the text file

Reported after install and the user's reload: chips appear for a pasted screenshot and an attached document, the sent message shows them, the assistant answers from their content, and a chip click opens the file
The whole plugin suite passes apart from the two manifest-catalog tests that failed before this Story, with its TAP output saved to a file named as evidence

tests.name: live claude: with the argv the adapter builds for a request with readDirs, a prompt naming an image and a text file in that directory is answered from their content
live codex: with the argv the adapter builds, a prompt naming an image and a text file in the attachments directory is answered from their content
in VS Code: pasting a screenshot and attaching a document show chips, the message shows them after sending, the assistant answers from their content, and a chip click opens the file
whole plugin suite: every test passes apart from the two manifest-catalog tests that failed before this Story
